topic: Get around the city, part 2: taxi and arriving

phrases.when: A woman says “perdida”, a man says “perdido”. Say it first, then ask for help.
“Ayudás” is the vos form. Argentines say it to anyone, in shops and on the street.
Ask the taxi driver before you go. “Tarda” means it takes time.
Say it to the driver near your door. “Acá” means here, very Argentine.

hook: Lost in the city? Four phrases.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.translation: I'm lost. Can you help me?
